questions.q: What first step does Michael Hyatt recommend for planning a great year?
a: Journal a vision of your future
questions.why: He suggests journaling about where you'd like to be a year from now.

questions.q: How many life areas does the book advise focusing on?
questions.why: The text lists ten aspects of life to focus on.

questions.q: What balance is needed when setting high goals?
questions.why: The book says set sights high while being reasonable about current capabilities.

questions.q: What benefit does hiring a coach provide, according to the author?
questions.why: The author notes progress improved quickly after hiring a coach.

questions.q: What common mistake does the book warn against when pursuing goals?
questions.why: It cites insanity as doing the same thing repeatedly expecting different results.
